hypothesis: Fitting harmonic note spectra before octave folding may reduce wrong-root predictions caused by energy from upper partials.
source: Mauch and Dixon (2010), sections 2.2-2.5 and Table 1; this is a simplified experiment with a different representation and decoder.
control: Frozen long8192 baseline; decay0 fits fundamental-only note profiles.
fixed: Audio, tuning, Hann8192, hop512, observation frequency span, MIDI36-95, N threshold and 24-triad Viterbi decoder with switch penalty4.
primary_metric: Duration-weighted major/minor accuracy on the unchanged scoreable reference duration.
secondary_metrics: root accuracy over all chord-scoreable duration
wrong-root seconds excluding predictions of N
selection: Consider only settings with improved overall accuracy and nonnegative improvement in both development families; retain the original baseline if none qualify.
scope: Development evidence only. The previously evaluated progression3 and IDMT material cannot provide a fresh test for this revision.
